summary: Fix correctly converts min_samples/min_cluster_size to int before use, resolving the reported TypeError when passing a float min_samples to OPTICS/NearestNeighbors. Approach is sound and consistent across both call sites; only minor style/doc nits remain.

issues.description: Uses int() truncation rather than round() (as proposed in the issue). This always rounds the fractional sample count down rather than to nearest, a minor behavioral difference from the reporter's suggested fix, though it still resolves the crash and produces a valid integer count.

Docstring for min_samples in cluster_optics_xi still says 'rounded to be at least 2' even though the implementation truncates rather than rounds; pre-existing wording not fully reconciled with the chosen int() approach.
